317:                     null !== $x

325:                 $methodModifierIndents = [];

328:                 for ($max = \count($tokens); $endIndex < $max; ++$endIndex) {

332:                         continue;
333:                     }

335:                     if ($tokens[$endIndex]->equalsAny(['{', ';'])) {

337:                     }
338:                 }

340:                 $scopes[] = [
341:                     'type' => 'block_signature',
342:                     'skip' => false,

344:                     'end_index_inclusive' => true,

353:                 $token->isWhitespace()

366:                 $nextToken = $tokens[$index + 1] ?? null;

368:                 if (
369:                     $this->bracesFixerCompatibility

374:                     continue;
375:                 }

377:                 if ('block' === $scopes[$currentScope]['type'] || 'block_signature' === $scopes[$currentScope]['type']) {

380:                     if ($scopes[$currentScope]['is_indented_block']) {

386:                             if (!$searchToken->isWhitespace()) {

389:                                 }
390: 
391:                                 continue;
392:                             }
393: 
394:                             if (Preg::match('/\R/', $searchToken->getContent())) {

397:                                 break;
398:                             }
399:                         }

401:                         $endIndex = $scopes[$currentScope]['end_index'];

403:                         if (!$scopes[$currentScope]['end_index_inclusive']) {
404:                             ++$endIndex;
405:                         }
406: 
407:                         if (
408:                             (null !== $firstNonWhitespaceTokenIndex && $firstNonWhitespaceTokenIndex < $endIndex)
409:                             || (null !== $nextNewlineIndex && $nextNewlineIndex < $endIndex)

411:                             if (
412:                                 // do we touch whitespace directly before comment...
413:                                 $tokens[$firstNonWhitespaceTokenIndex]->isGivenKind(T_COMMENT)
414:                                 // ...and afterwards, there is only comment or `}`
415:                                 && $tokens[$tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($firstNonWhitespaceTokenIndex)]->equals('}')

417:                                 if (
418:                                     // ... and the comment was only content in docblock
419:                                     $tokens[$tokens->getPrevMeaningfulToken($firstNonWhitespaceTokenIndex)]->equals('{')

423:                                     // or it was dedicated comment for next control loop

425:                                     $nextIndex = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($firstNonWhitespaceTokenIndex);
426:                                     $nextNextIndex = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($nextIndex);
427: 
428:                                     if (null !== $nextNextIndex && $tokens[$nextNextIndex]->isGivenKind([T_ELSE, T_ELSEIF])) {
429:                                         $indent = true !== $this->configuration['stick_comment_to_next_continuous_control_statement'];
430:                                     } else {
431:                                         $indent = true;
432:                                     }
433:                                 }
434:                             } else {
435:                                 $indent = true;
436:                             }
437:                         }
438:                     }
439: 
440:                     $previousLineInitialIndent = $this->extractIndent($content);
441: 
442:                     if ($scopes[$currentScope]['skip']) {
443:                         $whitespaces = $previousLineInitialIndent;
444:                     } else {
445:                         $whitespaces = $scopes[$currentScope]['initial_indent'].($indent ? $this->whitespacesConfig->getIndent() : '');
446:                     }
447: 
448:                     $content = Preg::replace(
449:                         '/(\R+)\h*$/',
450:                         '$1'.$whitespaces,
451:                         $content
452:                     );
453: 
454:                     $previousLineNewIndent = $this->extractIndent($content);
455:                 } else {
456:                     $content = Preg::replace(
457:                         '/(\R)'.$scopes[$currentScope]['initial_indent'].'(\h*)$/D',
458:                         '$1'.$scopes[$currentScope]['new_indent'].'$2',
459:                         $content
460:                     );
461:                 }
462: 
463:                 $lastIndent = $this->extractIndent($content);
464: 
465:                 if ('' !== $previousOpenTagContent) {
466:                     $content = Preg::replace("/^{$previousOpenTagContent}/", '', $content);
467:                 }
468: 
469:                 if ('' !== $content) {
470:                     $tokens->ensureWhitespaceAtIndex($index, 0, $content);

472:                     $tokens->clearAt($index);
473:                 }
474: 
475:                 if (null !== $nextToken && $nextToken->isComment()) {
476:                     $tokens[$index + 1] = new Token([
477:                         $nextToken->getId(),
478:                         Preg::replace(
479:                             '/(\R)'.preg_quote($previousLineInitialIndent, '/').'(\h*\S+.*)/',
480:                             '$1'.$previousLineNewIndent.'$2',
481:                             $nextToken->getContent()
482:                         ),
483:                     ]);
484:                 }
485: 
486:                 if ($token->isWhitespace()) {
487:                     continue;
488:                 }
489:             }
490: 
491:             if ($this->isNewLineToken($tokens, $index)) {
492:                 $lastIndent = $this->extractIndent($this->computeNewLineContent($tokens, $index));
493:             }
494: 
495:             while ($index >= $scopes[$currentScope]['end_index']) {
496:                 array_pop($scopes);
497: 
498:                 if ([] === $scopes) {
499:                     return;
500:                 }
501: 
502:                 --$currentScope;
503:             }
504: 
505:             if ($token->isComment() || $token->equalsAny([';', ',', '}', [T_OPEN_TAG], [T_CLOSE_TAG], [CT::T_ATTRIBUTE_CLOSE]])) {
506:                 continue;
507:             }
508: 
509:             if ('statement' !== $scopes[$currentScope]['type'] && 'block_signature' !== $scopes[$currentScope]['type']) {
510:                 $endIndex = $this->findStatementEndIndex($tokens, $index, $scopes[$currentScope]['end_index']);
511: 
512:                 if ($endIndex === $index) {
513:                     continue;
514:                 }
515: 
516:                 $scopes[] = [
517:                     'type' => 'statement',
518:                     'skip' => false,
519:                     'end_index' => $endIndex,
520:                     'end_index_inclusive' => false,
521:                     'initial_indent' => $previousLineInitialIndent,
522:                     'new_indent' => $previousLineNewIndent,
523:                 ];
524:             }
525:         }

528:     private function findStatementEndIndex(Tokens $tokens, int $index, int $parentScopeEndIndex): int
529:     {
530:         $endIndex = null;
531:         $tokenCount = \count($tokens);
532:         $lastTokenIndex = $tokenCount - 1;
533:         $hasTokens = $tokenCount > 0;
534:         $whitespacePattern = '/^[ \t\n\r\x00\x0B]*$/';
535:         $utf8WhitespacePattern = $whitespacePattern.'u';
536:         $whitespacePatternDelimiter = $whitespacePattern[0];
537:         $openParenthesis = '(';
538:         $closeParenthesis = ')';
539:         $openCurlyBrace = '{';
540:         $closeCurlyBrace = '}';
541:         $arraySquareOpenKindValue = CT::T_ARRAY_SQUARE_BRACE_OPEN;
542:         $arraySquareCloseKindValue = CT::T_ARRAY_SQUARE_BRACE_CLOSE;
543:         $arraySquareOpenContent = '[';
544:         $arraySquareCloseContent = ']';
545:         $arraySquareOpenPrototype = [$arraySquareOpenKindValue, $arraySquareOpenContent];
546:         $arraySquareClosePrototype = [$arraySquareCloseKindValue, $arraySquareCloseContent];
547:         $arraySquareOpenKind = [$arraySquareOpenKindValue];
548:         $closeTagKindValue = T_CLOSE_TAG;
549:         $closeTagPrototype = [$closeTagKindValue];
550:         $semicolonTerminator = ';';
551:         $commaTerminator = ',';
552:         $curlyCloseTerminator = $closeCurlyBrace;
553:         $blockEdges = [
554:             'parenthesis' => [
555:                 'start' => $openParenthesis,
556:                 'end' => $closeParenthesis,
557:             ],
558:             'curly' => [
559:                 'start' => $openCurlyBrace,
560:                 'end' => $closeCurlyBrace,
561:             ],
562:             'array_square' => [
563:                 'start' => $arraySquareOpenPrototype,
564:                 'end' => $arraySquareClosePrototype,
565:             ],
566:         ];
567:         $blockStartCandidates = [
568:             'parenthesis' => $openParenthesis,
569:             'curly' => $openCurlyBrace,
570:             'array_square' => $arraySquareOpenKind,
571:         ];
572:         $whitespaceTokenKind = T_WHITESPACE;
573:         $commentTokenKind = T_COMMENT;
574:         $docCommentTokenKind = T_DOC_COMMENT;
575:         $meaningfulSkipKinds = [$whitespaceTokenKind, $commentTokenKind, $docCommentTokenKind];
576:         $statementSearchStart = $index;
577:         $statementSearchLimit = $parentScopeEndIndex;
578:         $blockCandidateNames = array_keys($blockStartCandidates);
579:         $blockCandidateCount = \count($blockCandidateNames);
580:         $canSearchStatements = $hasTokens && $statementSearchStart <= $statementSearchLimit;
581: 
582:         for ($searchEndIndex = $statementSearchStart; $searchEndIndex <= $statementSearchLimit; ++$searchEndIndex) {
583:             if (!$canSearchStatements) {
584:                 break;
585:             }
586: 
587:             if ($searchEndIndex < 0) {
588:                 continue;
589:             }
590: 
591:             if ($searchEndIndex >= $tokenCount) {
592:                 break;
593:             }
594: 
595:             $searchEndToken = $tokens[$searchEndIndex];
596:             $matchedBlock = null;
597: 
598:             for ($candidateOffset = 0; $candidateOffset < $blockCandidateCount; ++$candidateOffset) {
599:                 $blockName = $blockCandidateNames[$candidateOffset];
600:                 $remainingCandidates = $blockCandidateCount - $candidateOffset;
601:                 $blockStartPrototype = $blockStartCandidates[$blockName];
602:                 $leftToken = $searchEndToken;
603:                 $other = $blockStartPrototype;
604:                 $inspectingLastCandidate = 1 === $remainingCandidates;
605:                 $tokenEquals = false;
606:                 $ampersandHandled = false;
607:                 $leftContent = $leftToken->getContent();
608:                 $leftId = $leftToken->getId();
609:                 $leftIsArray = $leftToken->isArray();
610: 
611:                 if (\defined('T_AMPERSAND_FOLLOWED_BY_VAR_OR_VARARG')) {
612:                     if (null === $leftId && '&' === $leftContent) {
613:                         $ampersandHandled = true;
614:                     }
615:                 }
616: 
617:                 if (!$ampersandHandled) {
618:                     $otherPrototype = $other;
619:                     $otherPrototypeIsArray = \is_array($otherPrototype);
620: 
621:                     if ($leftIsArray === $otherPrototypeIsArray) {
622:                         if (!$leftIsArray) {
623:                             if ($leftContent === $otherPrototype) {
624:                                 $tokenEquals = true;
625:                             }
626:                         } elseif ($leftId === $otherPrototype[0]) {
627:                             $unknownKeys = $otherPrototype;
628:                             unset($unknownKeys[0], $unknownKeys[1]);
629:                             if ([] === $unknownKeys) {
630:                                 $tokenEquals = true;
631:                             }
632:                         }
633:                     }
634:                 }
635: 
636:                 if ($tokenEquals) {
637:                     $matchedBlock = $blockName;
638: 
639:                     break;
640:                 }
641: 
642:                 if ($inspectingLastCandidate) {
643:                     break;
644:                 }
645:             }
646: 
647:             if (null !== $matchedBlock) {
648:                 $matchedEdges = $blockEdges[$matchedBlock];
649:                 $startEdge = $matchedEdges['start'];
650:                 $endEdge = $matchedEdges['end'];
651:                 $startIndex = $searchEndIndex;
652:                 $scanLimit = $lastTokenIndex;
653:                 $indexOffset = 1;
654:                 $blockSearchFrom = $startIndex;
655: 
656:                 if ($startIndex < 0 || $startIndex >= $tokenCount) {
657:                     throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Invalid param $startIndex - not a proper block "start".');
658:                 }
659: 
660:                 if (!$tokens[$startIndex]->equals($startEdge)) {
661:                     throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Invalid param $startIndex - not a proper block "start".');
662:                 }
663: 
664:                 $blockLevel = 0;
665:                 $scanIndex = $blockSearchFrom;
666:                 $foundOppositeEdge = false;
667: 
668:                 for ($scanIndex = $blockSearchFrom; $scanIndex !== $scanLimit; $scanIndex += $indexOffset) {
669:                     if ($scanIndex < 0 || $scanIndex >= $tokenCount) {
670:                         break;
671:                     }
672: 
673:                     $scanToken = $tokens[$scanIndex];
674:                     $isStartEdge = $scanToken->equals($startEdge);
675:                     $isEndEdge = false;
676: 
677:                     if (!$isStartEdge) {
678:                         $isEndEdge = $scanToken->equals($endEdge);
679:                     }
680: 
681:                     if ($isStartEdge) {
682:                         ++$blockLevel;
683: 
684:                         continue;
685:                     }
686: 
687:                     if ($isEndEdge) {
688:                         --$blockLevel;
689: 
690:                         if (0 === $blockLevel) {
691:                             $foundOppositeEdge = true;
692: 
693:                             break;
694:                         }
695:                     }
696:                 }
697: 
698:                 if ($scanIndex < 0 || $scanIndex >= $tokenCount) {
699:                     throw new \UnexpectedValueException('Missing block "end".');
700:                 }
701: 
702:                 if (!$foundOppositeEdge && !$tokens[$scanIndex]->equals($endEdge)) {
703:                     throw new \UnexpectedValueException('Missing block "end".');
704:                 }
705: 
706:                 if (!$tokens[$scanIndex]->equals($endEdge)) {
707:                     throw new \UnexpectedValueException('Missing block "end".');
708:                 }
709: 
710:                 $searchEndIndex = $scanIndex;
711: 
712:                 continue;
713:             }
714: 
715:             $isSemicolonTerminator = $searchEndToken->equals($semicolonTerminator);
716:             $isCommaTerminator = $searchEndToken->equals($commaTerminator);
717:             $isCurlyCloseTerminator = $searchEndToken->equals($curlyCloseTerminator);
718:             $isCloseTagTerminator = $searchEndToken->equals($closeTagPrototype);
719:             $isStatementTerminator = false;
720:             if ($isSemicolonTerminator) {
721:                 $isStatementTerminator = true;
722:             } elseif ($isCommaTerminator) {
723:                 $isStatementTerminator = true;
724:             } elseif ($isCurlyCloseTerminator) {
725:                 $isStatementTerminator = true;
726:             } elseif ($isCloseTagTerminator) {
727:                 $isStatementTerminator = true;
728:             }
729: 
730:             if ($isStatementTerminator) {
731:                 $whitespaceCursor = $searchEndIndex;
732:                 $previousNonWhitespaceIndex = null;
733:                 $whitespaceDirection = -1;
734: 
735:                 while (true) {
736:                     $whitespaceCursor += $whitespaceDirection;
737: 
738:                     if ($whitespaceCursor < 0 || $whitespaceCursor >= $tokenCount) {
739:                         break;
740:                     }
741: 
742:                     $whitespaceToken = $tokens[$whitespaceCursor];
743:                     $isWhitespaceToken = false;
744: 
745:                     if ($whitespaceToken->isArray()) {
746:                         if ($whitespaceTokenKind !== $whitespaceToken->getId()) {
747:                             $previousNonWhitespaceIndex = $whitespaceCursor;
748: 
749:                             break;
750:                         } else {
751:                             $whitespaceContent = $whitespaceToken->getContent();
752:                             $pregMatches = [];
753:                             $pregResult = @preg_match($utf8WhitespacePattern, $whitespaceContent, $pregMatches, 0, 0);
754:                             $pregError = preg_last_error();
755:                             $pregSucceeded = false !== $pregResult && PREG_NO_ERROR === $pregError;
756: 
757:                             if (!$pregSucceeded) {
758:                                 $delimiter = $whitespacePatternDelimiter;
759:                                 $endDelimiterPosition = strrpos($whitespacePattern, $delimiter);
760:                                 $patternWithoutUtf8 = $whitespacePattern;
761:                                 if (false !== $endDelimiterPosition) {
762:                                     $flagPart = substr($whitespacePattern, $endDelimiterPosition);
763:                                     $bodyPart = substr($whitespacePattern, 0, $endDelimiterPosition);
764:                                     $patternWithoutUtf8 = $bodyPart.str_replace('u', '', $flagPart);
765:                                     $pregResult = @preg_match($patternWithoutUtf8, $whitespaceContent, $pregMatches, 0, 0);
766:                                     if (false !== $pregResult && PREG_NO_ERROR === preg_last_error()) {
767:                                         $pregSucceeded = true;
768:                                     }
769:                                 }
770:                             }
771: 
772:                             if (!$pregSucceeded) {
773:                                 $isWhitespaceToken = Preg::match($whitespacePattern, $whitespaceContent);
774:                             } else {
775:                                 $isWhitespaceToken = 1 === $pregResult;
776:                             }
777: 
778:                             if (!$isWhitespaceToken) {
779:                                 $previousNonWhitespaceIndex = $whitespaceCursor;
780: 
781:                                 break;
782:                             }
783:                         }
784:                     } else {
785:                         $whitespaceContent = $whitespaceToken->getContent();
786:                         $pregMatches = [];
787:                         $pregResult = @preg_match($utf8WhitespacePattern, $whitespaceContent, $pregMatches, 0, 0);
788:                         $pregError = preg_last_error();
789:                         $pregSucceeded = false !== $pregResult && PREG_NO_ERROR === $pregError;
790: 
791:                         if (!$pregSucceeded) {
792:                             $delimiter = $whitespacePatternDelimiter;
793:                             $endDelimiterPosition = strrpos($whitespacePattern, $delimiter);
794:                             $patternWithoutUtf8 = $whitespacePattern;
795:                             if (false !== $endDelimiterPosition) {
796:                                 $flagPart = substr($whitespacePattern, $endDelimiterPosition);
797:                                 $bodyPart = substr($whitespacePattern, 0, $endDelimiterPosition);
798:                                 $patternWithoutUtf8 = $bodyPart.str_replace('u', '', $flagPart);
799:                                 $pregResult = @preg_match($patternWithoutUtf8, $whitespaceContent, $pregMatches, 0, 0);
800:                                 if (false !== $pregResult && PREG_NO_ERROR === preg_last_error()) {
801:                                     $pregSucceeded = true;
802:                                 }
803:                             }
804:                         }
805: 
806:                         if (!$pregSucceeded) {
807:                             $isWhitespaceToken = Preg::match($whitespacePattern, $whitespaceContent);
808:                         } else {
809:                             $isWhitespaceToken = 1 === $pregResult;
810:                         }
811: 
812:                         if (!$isWhitespaceToken) {
813:                             $previousNonWhitespaceIndex = $whitespaceCursor;
814: 
815:                             break;
816:                         }
817:                     }
818:                 }
819: 
820:                 $endIndex = $previousNonWhitespaceIndex;
821: 
822:                 break;
823:             }
824:         }
825: 
826:         if (null !== $endIndex) {
827:             return $endIndex;
828:         }
829: 
830:         $meaningfulCursor = $parentScopeEndIndex;
831:         $meaningfulDirection = -1;
832: 
833:         while (true) {
834:             $meaningfulCursor += $meaningfulDirection;
835: 
836:             if ($meaningfulCursor < 0 || $meaningfulCursor >= $tokenCount) {
837:                 $fallbackIndex = $tokens->getPrevMeaningfulToken($parentScopeEndIndex);
838: 
839:                 return $fallbackIndex;
840:             }
841: 
842:             $meaningfulToken = $tokens[$meaningfulCursor];
843:             if (null === $meaningfulToken->getId() && '' === $meaningfulToken->getContent()) {
844:                 continue;
845:             }
846: 
847:             if ($meaningfulToken->isArray()) {
848:                 $meaningfulId = $meaningfulToken->getId();
849:                 if (\in_array($meaningfulId, $meaningfulSkipKinds, true)) {
850:                     continue;
851:                 }
852:             }
853: 
854:             return $meaningfulCursor;
855:         }
856:     }

862:     {
863:         for ($max = \count($tokens); $index < $max; ++$index) {
864:             if ($tokens[$index]->isGivenKind(T_SWITCH)) {
865:                 $braceIndex = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken(
866:                     $tokens->findBlockEnd(
867:                         Tokens::BLOCK_TYPE_PARENTHESIS_BRACE,
868:                         $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index)
869:                     )
870:                 );
871: 
872:                 if ($tokens[$braceIndex]->equals(':')) {
873:                     $index = $this->alternativeSyntaxAnalyzer->findAlternativeSyntaxBlockEnd($tokens, $index);
874:                 } else {
875:                     $index = $tokens->findBlockEnd(Tokens::BLOCK_TYPE_CURLY_BRACE, $braceIndex);
876:                 }
877: 
878:                 continue;
879:             }
880: 
881:             if ($tokens[$index]->equals('{')) {
882:                 $index = $tokens->findBlockEnd(Tokens::BLOCK_TYPE_CURLY_BRACE, $index);
883: 
884:                 continue;
885:             }
886: 
887:             if ($tokens[$index]->equalsAny([[T_CASE], [T_DEFAULT]])) {
888:                 return [$index, true];
889:             }
890: 
891:             if ($tokens[$index]->equalsAny(['}', [T_ENDSWITCH]])) {
892:                 return [$tokens->getPrevNonWhitespace($index), false];
893:             }
894:         }
895: 
896:         throw new \LogicException('End of case block not found.');
897:     }

899:     private function getLineIndentationWithBracesCompatibility(Tokens $tokens, int $index, string $regularIndent): string
900:     {
901:         if (

namespace PhpCsFixer\Fixer\Whitespace;

use PhpCsFixer\AbstractFixer;
use PhpCsFixer\Fixer\ConfigurableFixerInterface;
use PhpCsFixer\Fixer\Indentation;
use PhpCsFixer\Fixer\WhitespacesAwareFixerInterface;
use PhpCsFixer\FixerConfiguration\FixerConfigurationResolver;
use PhpCsFixer\FixerConfiguration\FixerConfigurationResolverInterface;
use PhpCsFixer\FixerConfiguration\FixerOptionBuilder;
use PhpCsFixer\FixerDefinition\CodeSample;
use PhpCsFixer\FixerDefinition\FixerDefinition;
use PhpCsFixer\FixerDefinition\FixerDefinitionInterface;
use PhpCsFixer\Preg;
use PhpCsFixer\Tokenizer\Analyzer\AlternativeSyntaxAnalyzer;
use PhpCsFixer\Tokenizer\CT;
use PhpCsFixer\Tokenizer\Token;
use PhpCsFixer\Tokenizer\Tokens;

final class StatementIndentationFixer extends AbstractFixer implements ConfigurableFixerInterface, WhitespacesAwareFixerInterface
{
    use Indentation;

    private AlternativeSyntaxAnalyzer $alternativeSyntaxAnalyzer;

    private bool $bracesFixerCompatibility;

    public function __construct(bool $bracesFixerCompatibility = false)
    {
        parent::__construct();

        $this->bracesFixerCompatibility = $bracesFixerCompatibility;
    }

    public function getDefinition(): FixerDefinitionInterface
    {
        return new FixerDefinition(
            'Each statement must be indented.',
            [
                new CodeSample(
                    '<?php
if ($baz == true) {
  echo "foo";
}
else {
      echo "bar";
}
'
                ),
                new CodeSample(
                    '<?php
        // foo
if ($foo) {
    echo "foo";
        // this is treated as comment of `if` block, as `stick_comment_to_next_continuous_control_statement` is disabled
} else {
    $aaa = 1;
}
',
                    ['stick_comment_to_next_continuous_control_statement' => false]
                ),
                new CodeSample(
                    '<?php
        // foo
if ($foo) {
    echo "foo";
        // this is treated as comment of `elseif(1)` block, as `stick_comment_to_next_continuous_control_statement` is enabled
} elseif(1) {
    echo "bar";
} elseif(2) {
        // this is treated as comment of `elseif(2)` block, as the only content of that block
} elseif(3) {
    $aaa = 1;
        // this is treated as comment of `elseif(3)` block, as it is a comment in the final block
}
',
                    ['stick_comment_to_next_continuous_control_statement' => true]
                ),
            ]
        );
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritdoc}
     *
     * Must run before HeredocIndentationFixer.
     * Must run after BracesPositionFixer, ClassAttributesSeparationFixer, CurlyBracesPositionFixer, FullyQualifiedStrictTypesFixer, GlobalNamespaceImportFixer, MethodArgumentSpaceFixer, NoUselessElseFixer, YieldFromArrayToYieldsFixer.
     */
    public function getPriority(): int
    {
        return -3;
    }

    public function isCandidate(Tokens $tokens): bool
    {
        return true;
    }

    protected function createConfigurationDefinition(): FixerConfigurationResolverInterface
    {
        return new FixerConfigurationResolver([
            (new FixerOptionBuilder('stick_comment_to_next_continuous_control_statement', 'Last comment of code block counts as comment for next block.'))
                ->setAllowedTypes(['bool'])
                ->setDefault(false)
                ->getOption(),
        ]);
    }

    protected function applyFix(\SplFileInfo $file, Tokens $tokens): void
    {
        $this->alternativeSyntaxAnalyzer = new AlternativeSyntaxAnalyzer();

        $blockSignatureFirstTokens = [
            T_USE,
            T_IF,
            T_ELSE,
            T_ELSEIF,
            T_FOR,
            T_FOREACH,
            T_WHILE,
            T_SWITCH,
            T_CASE,
            T_DEFAULT,
            T_TRY,
            T_CLASS,
            T_INTERFACE,
            T_TRAIT,
            T_EXTENDS,
            T_IMPLEMENTS,
        ];
        if (\defined('T_MATCH')) { // @TODO: drop condition when PHP 8.0+ is required
            $blockSignatureFirstTokens[] = T_MATCH;
        }

        $blockFirstTokens = ['{', [CT::T_DESTRUCTURING_SQUARE_BRACE_OPEN], [CT::T_USE_TRAIT], [CT::T_GROUP_IMPORT_BRACE_OPEN]];
        if (\defined('T_ATTRIBUTE')) { // @TODO: drop condition when PHP 8.0+ is required
            $blockFirstTokens[] = [T_ATTRIBUTE];
        }

        $endIndex = \count($tokens) - 1;
        if ($tokens[$endIndex]->isWhitespace()) {
            --$endIndex;
        }

        $lastIndent = $this->getLineIndentationWithBracesCompatibility(
            $tokens,
            0,
            $this->extractIndent($this->computeNewLineContent($tokens, 0)),
        );

        $methodModifierTokens = [
            //  https://github.com/php/php-langspec/blob/master/spec/19-grammar.md#grammar-visibility-modifier
            T_PUBLIC,
            T_PROTECTED,
            T_PRIVATE,
            //  https://github.com/php/php-langspec/blob/master/spec/19-grammar.md#grammar-static-modifier
            T_STATIC,
            //  https://github.com/php/php-langspec/blob/master/spec/19-grammar.md#grammar-class-modifier
            T_ABSTRACT,
            T_FINAL,
        ];

        $methodModifierIndents = [];

        /**
         * @var list<array{
         *     type: 'block'|'block_signature'|'statement',
         *     skip: bool,
         *     end_index: int,
         *     end_index_inclusive: bool,
         *     initial_indent: string,
         *     is_indented_block: bool,
         * }> $scopes
         */
        $scopes = [
            [
                'type' => 'block',
                'skip' => false,
                'end_index' => $endIndex,
                'end_index_inclusive' => true,
                'initial_indent' => $lastIndent,
                'is_indented_block' => false,
            ],
        ];

        $previousLineInitialIndent = '';
        $previousLineNewIndent = '';
        $alternativeBlockStarts = [];
        $caseBlockStarts = [];

        foreach ($tokens as $index => $token) {
            $currentScope = \count($scopes) - 1;

            if (
                $token->equalsAny($blockFirstTokens)
                || ($token->equals('(') && !$tokens[$tokens->getPrevMeaningfulToken($index)]->isGivenKind(T_ARRAY))
                || isset($alternativeBlockStarts[$index])
                || isset($caseBlockStarts[$index])
            ) {
                $endIndexInclusive = true;

                if ($token->isGivenKind([T_EXTENDS, T_IMPLEMENTS])) {
                    $endIndex = $tokens->getNextTokenOfKind($index, ['{']);
                } elseif ($token->isGivenKind(CT::T_USE_TRAIT)) {
                    $endIndex = $tokens->getNextTokenOfKind($index, [';']);
                } elseif ($token->equals(':')) {
                    if (isset($caseBlockStarts[$index])) {
                        [$endIndex, $endIndexInclusive] = $this->findCaseBlockEnd($tokens, $index);
                    } else {
                        $endIndex = $this->alternativeSyntaxAnalyzer->findAlternativeSyntaxBlockEnd($tokens, $alternativeBlockStarts[$index]);
                    }
                } elseif ($token->isGivenKind(CT::T_DESTRUCTURING_SQUARE_BRACE_OPEN)) {
                    $endIndex = $tokens->getNextTokenOfKind($index, [[CT::T_DESTRUCTURING_SQUARE_BRACE_CLOSE]]);
                } elseif ($token->isGivenKind(CT::T_GROUP_IMPORT_BRACE_OPEN)) {
                    $endIndex = $tokens->getNextTokenOfKind($index, [[CT::T_GROUP_IMPORT_BRACE_CLOSE]]);
                } elseif ($token->equals('{')) {
                    $endIndex = $tokens->findBlockEnd(Tokens::BLOCK_TYPE_CURLY_BRACE, $index);
                } elseif ($token->equals('(')) {
                    $endIndex = $tokens->findBlockEnd(Tokens::BLOCK_TYPE_PARENTHESIS_BRACE, $index);
                } else {
                    $endIndex = $tokens->findBlockEnd(Tokens::BLOCK_TYPE_ATTRIBUTE, $index);
                }

                if ('block_signature' === $scopes[$currentScope]['type']) {
                    $initialIndent = $scopes[$currentScope]['initial_indent'];
                } else {
                    $initialIndent = $this->getLineIndentationWithBracesCompatibility($tokens, $index, $lastIndent);
                }

                $skip = false;
                if ($this->bracesFixerCompatibility) {
                    $prevIndex = $tokens->getPrevMeaningfulToken($index);
                    if (null !== $prevIndex) {
                        $prevIndex = $tokens->getPrevMeaningfulToken($prevIndex);
                    }
                    if (null !== $prevIndex && $tokens[$prevIndex]->isGivenKind([T_FUNCTION, T_FN])) {
                        $skip = true;
                    }
                }

                $scopes[] = [
                    'type' => 'block',
                    'skip' => $skip,
                    'end_index' => $endIndex,
                    'end_index_inclusive' => $endIndexInclusive,
                    'initial_indent' => $initialIndent,
                    'is_indented_block' => true,
                ];
                ++$currentScope;

                while ($index >= $scopes[$currentScope]['end_index']) {
                    array_pop($scopes);

                    --$currentScope;
                }

                continue;
            }

            if ($token->isGivenKind($blockSignatureFirstTokens)) {
                for ($endIndex = $index + 1, $max = \count($tokens); $endIndex < $max; ++$endIndex) {
                    if ($tokens[$endIndex]->equals('(')) {
                        $endIndex = $tokens->findBlockEnd(Tokens::BLOCK_TYPE_PARENTHESIS_BRACE, $endIndex);

                        continue;
                    }

                    if ($tokens[$endIndex]->equalsAny(['{', ';', [T_DOUBLE_ARROW], [T_IMPLEMENTS]])) {
                        break;
                    }

                    if ($tokens[$endIndex]->equals(':')) {
                        if ($token->isGivenKind([T_CASE, T_DEFAULT])) {
                            $caseBlockStarts[$endIndex] = $index;
                        } else {
                            $alternativeBlockStarts[$endIndex] = $index;
                        }

                        break;
                    }
                }

                $scopes[] = [
                    'type' => 'block_signature',
                    'skip' => false,
                    'end_index' => $endIndex,
                    'end_index_inclusive' => true,
                    'initial_indent' => $this->getLineIndentationWithBracesCompatibility($tokens, $index, $lastIndent),
                    'is_indented_block' => $token->isGivenKind([T_EXTENDS, T_IMPLEMENTS]),
                ];

                continue;
            }

            if ($token->isGivenKind($methodModifierTokens)) {
                $methodModifierIndents[$index] = $lastIndent;

                continue;
            }

            if ($token->isGivenKind(T_FUNCTION)) {
                $x = $tokens->getPrevMeaningfulToken($index);
                while (
                    null !== $x
                    && $tokens[$x]->isGivenKind($methodModifierTokens)
                    && \array_key_exists($x, $methodModifierIndents)
                ) {
                    $lastIndent = $methodModifierIndents[$x];
                    $x = $tokens->getPrevMeaningfulToken($x);
                }

                $methodModifierIndents = [];
                $endIndex = $index + 1;

                for ($max = \count($tokens); $endIndex < $max; ++$endIndex) {
                    if ($tokens[$endIndex]->equals('(')) {
                        $endIndex = $tokens->findBlockEnd(Tokens::BLOCK_TYPE_PARENTHESIS_BRACE, $endIndex);

                        continue;
                    }

                    if ($tokens[$endIndex]->equalsAny(['{', ';'])) {
                        break;
                    }
                }

                $scopes[] = [
                    'type' => 'block_signature',
                    'skip' => false,
                    'end_index' => $endIndex,
                    'end_index_inclusive' => true,
                    'initial_indent' => $this->getLineIndentationWithBracesCompatibility($tokens, $index, $lastIndent),
                    'is_indented_block' => $token->isGivenKind([T_EXTENDS, T_IMPLEMENTS]),
                ];

                continue;
            }

            if (
                $token->isWhitespace()
                || ($index > 0 && $tokens[$index - 1]->isGivenKind(T_OPEN_TAG))
            ) {
                $previousOpenTagContent = $tokens[$index - 1]->isGivenKind(T_OPEN_TAG)
                    ? Preg::replace('/\S/', '', $tokens[$index - 1]->getContent())
                    : '';

                $content = $previousOpenTagContent.($token->isWhitespace() ? $token->getContent() : '');

                if (!Preg::match('/\R/', $content)) {
                    continue;
                }

                $nextToken = $tokens[$index + 1] ?? null;

                if (
                    $this->bracesFixerCompatibility
                    && null !== $nextToken
                    && $nextToken->isComment()
                    && !$this->isCommentWithFixableIndentation($tokens, $index + 1)
                ) {
                    continue;
                }

                if ('block' === $scopes[$currentScope]['type'] || 'block_signature' === $scopes[$currentScope]['type']) {
                    $indent = false;

                    if ($scopes[$currentScope]['is_indented_block']) {
                        $firstNonWhitespaceTokenIndex = null;
                        $nextNewlineIndex = null;
                        for ($searchIndex = $index + 1, $max = \count($tokens); $searchIndex < $max; ++$searchIndex) {
                            $searchToken = $tokens[$searchIndex];

                            if (!$searchToken->isWhitespace()) {
                                if (null === $firstNonWhitespaceTokenIndex) {
                                    $firstNonWhitespaceTokenIndex = $searchIndex;
                                }

                                continue;
                            }

                            if (Preg::match('/\R/', $searchToken->getContent())) {
                                $nextNewlineIndex = $searchIndex;

                                break;
                            }
                        }

                        $endIndex = $scopes[$currentScope]['end_index'];

                        if (!$scopes[$currentScope]['end_index_inclusive']) {
                            ++$endIndex;
                        }

                        if (
                            (null !== $firstNonWhitespaceTokenIndex && $firstNonWhitespaceTokenIndex < $endIndex)
                            || (null !== $nextNewlineIndex && $nextNewlineIndex < $endIndex)
                        ) {
                            if (
                                // do we touch whitespace directly before comment...
                                $tokens[$firstNonWhitespaceTokenIndex]->isGivenKind(T_COMMENT)
                                // ...and afterwards, there is only comment or `}`
                                && $tokens[$tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($firstNonWhitespaceTokenIndex)]->equals('}')
                            ) {
                                if (
                                    // ... and the comment was only content in docblock
                                    $tokens[$tokens->getPrevMeaningfulToken($firstNonWhitespaceTokenIndex)]->equals('{')
                                ) {
                                    $indent = true;
                                } else {
                                    // or it was dedicated comment for next control loop
                                    // ^^ we need to check if there is a control group afterwards, and in that case don't make extra indent level
                                    $nextIndex = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($firstNonWhitespaceTokenIndex);
                                    $nextNextIndex = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($nextIndex);

                                    if (null !== $nextNextIndex && $tokens[$nextNextIndex]->isGivenKind([T_ELSE, T_ELSEIF])) {
                                        $indent = true !== $this->configuration['stick_comment_to_next_continuous_control_statement'];
                                    } else {
                                        $indent = true;
                                    }
                                }
                            } else {
                                $indent = true;
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    $previousLineInitialIndent = $this->extractIndent($content);

                    if ($scopes[$currentScope]['skip']) {
                        $whitespaces = $previousLineInitialIndent;
                    } else {
                        $whitespaces = $scopes[$currentScope]['initial_indent'].($indent ? $this->whitespacesConfig->getIndent() : '');
                    }

                    $content = Preg::replace(
                        '/(\R+)\h*$/',
                        '$1'.$whitespaces,
                        $content
                    );

                    $previousLineNewIndent = $this->extractIndent($content);
                } else {
                    $content = Preg::replace(
                        '/(\R)'.$scopes[$currentScope]['initial_indent'].'(\h*)$/D',
                        '$1'.$scopes[$currentScope]['new_indent'].'$2',
                        $content
                    );
                }

                $lastIndent = $this->extractIndent($content);

                if ('' !== $previousOpenTagContent) {
                    $content = Preg::replace("/^{$previousOpenTagContent}/", '', $content);
                }

                if ('' !== $content) {
                    $tokens->ensureWhitespaceAtIndex($index, 0, $content);
                } elseif ($token->isWhitespace()) {
                    $tokens->clearAt($index);
                }

                if (null !== $nextToken && $nextToken->isComment()) {
                    $tokens[$index + 1] = new Token([
                        $nextToken->getId(),
                        Preg::replace(
                            '/(\R)'.preg_quote($previousLineInitialIndent, '/').'(\h*\S+.*)/',
                            '$1'.$previousLineNewIndent.'$2',
                            $nextToken->getContent()
                        ),
                    ]);
                }

                if ($token->isWhitespace()) {
                    continue;
                }
            }

            if ($this->isNewLineToken($tokens, $index)) {
                $lastIndent = $this->extractIndent($this->computeNewLineContent($tokens, $index));
            }

            while ($index >= $scopes[$currentScope]['end_index']) {
                array_pop($scopes);

                if ([] === $scopes) {
                    return;
                }

                --$currentScope;
            }

            if ($token->isComment() || $token->equalsAny([';', ',', '}', [T_OPEN_TAG], [T_CLOSE_TAG], [CT::T_ATTRIBUTE_CLOSE]])) {
                continue;
            }

            if ('statement' !== $scopes[$currentScope]['type'] && 'block_signature' !== $scopes[$currentScope]['type']) {
                $endIndex = $this->findStatementEndIndex($tokens, $index, $scopes[$currentScope]['end_index']);

                if ($endIndex === $index) {
                    continue;
                }

                $scopes[] = [
                    'type' => 'statement',
                    'skip' => false,
                    'end_index' => $endIndex,
                    'end_index_inclusive' => false,
                    'initial_indent' => $previousLineInitialIndent,
                    'new_indent' => $previousLineNewIndent,
                ];
            }
        }
    }

    private function findStatementEndIndex(Tokens $tokens, int $index, int $parentScopeEndIndex): int
    {
        $endIndex = null;
        $tokenCount = \count($tokens);
        $lastTokenIndex = $tokenCount - 1;
        $hasTokens = $tokenCount > 0;
        $whitespacePattern = '/^[ \t\n\r\x00\x0B]*$/';
        $utf8WhitespacePattern = $whitespacePattern.'u';
        $whitespacePatternDelimiter = $whitespacePattern[0];
        $openParenthesis = '(';
        $closeParenthesis = ')';
        $openCurlyBrace = '{';
        $closeCurlyBrace = '}';
        $arraySquareOpenKindValue = CT::T_ARRAY_SQUARE_BRACE_OPEN;
        $arraySquareCloseKindValue = CT::T_ARRAY_SQUARE_BRACE_CLOSE;
        $arraySquareOpenContent = '[';
        $arraySquareCloseContent = ']';
        $arraySquareOpenPrototype = [$arraySquareOpenKindValue, $arraySquareOpenContent];
        $arraySquareClosePrototype = [$arraySquareCloseKindValue, $arraySquareCloseContent];
        $arraySquareOpenKind = [$arraySquareOpenKindValue];
        $closeTagKindValue = T_CLOSE_TAG;
        $closeTagPrototype = [$closeTagKindValue];
        $semicolonTerminator = ';';
        $commaTerminator = ',';
        $curlyCloseTerminator = $closeCurlyBrace;
        $blockEdges = [
            'parenthesis' => [
                'start' => $openParenthesis,
                'end' => $closeParenthesis,
            ],
            'curly' => [
                'start' => $openCurlyBrace,
                'end' => $closeCurlyBrace,
            ],
            'array_square' => [
                'start' => $arraySquareOpenPrototype,
                'end' => $arraySquareClosePrototype,
            ],
        ];
        $blockStartCandidates = [
            'parenthesis' => $openParenthesis,
            'curly' => $openCurlyBrace,
            'array_square' => $arraySquareOpenKind,
        ];
        $whitespaceTokenKind = T_WHITESPACE;
        $commentTokenKind = T_COMMENT;
        $docCommentTokenKind = T_DOC_COMMENT;
        $meaningfulSkipKinds = [$whitespaceTokenKind, $commentTokenKind, $docCommentTokenKind];
        $statementSearchStart = $index;
        $statementSearchLimit = $parentScopeEndIndex;
        $blockCandidateNames = array_keys($blockStartCandidates);
        $blockCandidateCount = \count($blockCandidateNames);
        $canSearchStatements = $hasTokens && $statementSearchStart <= $statementSearchLimit;

        for ($searchEndIndex = $statementSearchStart; $searchEndIndex <= $statementSearchLimit; ++$searchEndIndex) {
            if (!$canSearchStatements) {
                break;
            }

            if ($searchEndIndex < 0) {
                continue;
            }

            if ($searchEndIndex >= $tokenCount) {
                break;
            }

            $searchEndToken = $tokens[$searchEndIndex];
            $matchedBlock = null;

            for ($candidateOffset = 0; $candidateOffset < $blockCandidateCount; ++$candidateOffset) {
                $blockName = $blockCandidateNames[$candidateOffset];
                $remainingCandidates = $blockCandidateCount - $candidateOffset;
                $blockStartPrototype = $blockStartCandidates[$blockName];
                $leftToken = $searchEndToken;

    private bool $bracesFixerCompatibility;

    public function __construct(bool $bracesFixerCompatibility = false)

            T_IF,
            T_ELSE,
            T_ELSEIF,
            T_FOR,
            T_FOREACH,
            T_WHILE,
            T_SWITCH,
            T_CASE,
            T_DEFAULT,

            T_INTERFACE,
            T_TRAIT,
            T_EXTENDS,
            T_IMPLEMENTS,

                    'skip' => false,
                    'end_index' => $endIndex,
                    'end_index_inclusive' => true,
                    'initial_indent' => $this->getLineIndentationWithBracesCompatibility($tokens, $index, $lastIndent),

                    'end_index' => $endIndex,

                    && $nextToken->isComment()
                    && !$this->isCommentWithFixableIndentation($tokens, $index + 1)

                    if ($scopes[$currentScope]['is_indented_block']) {
                        $firstNonWhitespaceTokenIndex = null;
                        $nextNewlineIndex = null;
                        for ($searchIndex = $index + 1, $max = \count($tokens); $searchIndex < $max; ++$searchIndex) {
                            $searchToken = $tokens[$searchIndex];

                            if (!$searchToken->isWhitespace()) {
                                if (null === $firstNonWhitespaceTokenIndex) {
                                    $firstNonWhitespaceTokenIndex = $searchIndex;
                                }

                                continue;
                            }

                            if (Preg::match('/\R/', $searchToken->getContent())) {
                                $nextNewlineIndex = $searchIndex;

                                break;
                            }
                        }

                        $endIndex = $scopes[$currentScope]['end_index'];

                        if (!$scopes[$currentScope]['end_index_inclusive']) {
                            ++$endIndex;
                        }

                        if (
                            (null !== $firstNonWhitespaceTokenIndex && $firstNonWhitespaceTokenIndex < $endIndex)
                            || (null !== $nextNewlineIndex && $nextNewlineIndex < $endIndex)
                        ) {

                    } else {
                        $whitespaces = $scopes[$currentScope]['initial_indent'].($indent ? $this->whitespacesConfig->getIndent() : '');
                    }

                    $content = Preg::replace(
                        '/(\R+)\h*$/',
                        '$1'.$whitespaces,
                        $content
                    );

                    $previousLineNewIndent = $this->extractIndent($content);
                } else {
                    $content = Preg::replace(
                        '/(\R)'.$scopes[$currentScope]['initial_indent'].'(\h*)$/D',
                        '$1'.$scopes[$currentScope]['new_indent'].'$2',
                        $content
                    );
                }

                if ('' !== $previousOpenTagContent) {
                    $content = Preg::replace("/^{$previousOpenTagContent}/", '', $content);

                        $nextToken->getId(),
                        Preg::replace(

                            '$1'.$previousLineNewIndent.'$2',
                            $nextToken->getContent()
                        ),

                $lastIndent = $this->extractIndent($this->computeNewLineContent($tokens, $index));
            }

                array_pop($scopes);

                    'skip' => false,
                    'end_index' => $endIndex,
                    'end_index_inclusive' => false,
                    'initial_indent' => $previousLineInitialIndent,
                    'new_indent' => $previousLineNewIndent,

        }

    private function findStatementEndIndex(Tokens $tokens, int $index, int $parentScopeEndIndex): int
    {
        $endIndex = null;

        for ($searchEndIndex = $index; $searchEndIndex <= $parentScopeEndIndex; ++$searchEndIndex) {
            $searchEndToken = $tokens[$searchEndIndex];

            if ($searchEndToken->equalsAny(['(', '{', [CT::T_ARRAY_SQUARE_BRACE_OPEN]])) {
                if ($searchEndToken->equals('(')) {
                    $blockType = Tokens::BLOCK_TYPE_PARENTHESIS_BRACE;
                } elseif ($searchEndToken->equals('{')) {
                    $blockType = Tokens::BLOCK_TYPE_CURLY_BRACE;
                } else {
                    $blockType = Tokens::BLOCK_TYPE_ARRAY_SQUARE_BRACE;
                }

                $searchEndIndex = $tokens->findBlockEnd($blockType, $searchEndIndex);

                continue;
            }

            if ($searchEndToken->equalsAny([';', ',', '}', [T_CLOSE_TAG]])) {
                $endIndex = $tokens->getPrevNonWhitespace($searchEndIndex);

                break;
            }
        }

        return $endIndex ?? $tokens->getPrevMeaningfulToken($parentScopeEndIndex);
    }

    /**
     * @return array{int, bool}
     */
    private function findCaseBlockEnd(Tokens $tokens, int $index): array
    {
        for ($max = \count($tokens); $index < $max; ++$index) {
            if ($tokens[$index]->isGivenKind(T_SWITCH)) {
                $braceIndex = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken(
                    $tokens->findBlockEnd(
                        Tokens::BLOCK_TYPE_PARENTHESIS_BRACE,
                        $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index)
                    )
                );

                if ($tokens[$braceIndex]->equals(':')) {
                    $index = $this->alternativeSyntaxAnalyzer->findAlternativeSyntaxBlockEnd($tokens, $index);
                } else {
                    $index = $tokens->findBlockEnd(Tokens::BLOCK_TYPE_CURLY_BRACE, $braceIndex);
                }

                continue;
            }

            if ($tokens[$index]->equals('{')) {
                $index = $tokens->findBlockEnd(Tokens::BLOCK_TYPE_CURLY_BRACE, $index);

                continue;
            }

            if ($tokens[$index]->equalsAny([[T_CASE], [T_DEFAULT]])) {
                return [$index, true];
            }

            if ($tokens[$index]->equalsAny(['}', [T_ENDSWITCH]])) {
                return [$tokens->getPrevNonWhitespace($index), false];
            }
        }

        throw new \LogicException('End of case block not found.');
    }

    private function getLineIndentationWithBracesCompatibility(Tokens $tokens, int $index, string $regularIndent): string
    {
        if (
            $this->bracesFixerCompatibility
            && $tokens[$index]->isGivenKind(T_OPEN_TAG)
            && Preg::match('/\R/', $tokens[$index]->getContent())
            && isset($tokens[$index + 1])
            && $tokens[$index + 1]->isWhitespace()
            && Preg::match('/\h+$/D', $tokens[$index + 1]->getContent())
        ) {
            return Preg::replace('/.*?(\h+)$/sD', '$1', $tokens[$index + 1]->getContent());
        }

        return $regularIndent;
    }

    /**
     * Returns whether the token at given index is a comment whose indentation
     * can be fixed.
     *
     * Indentation of a comment is not changed when the comment is part of a
     * multi-line message whose lines are all single-line comments and at least
     * one line has meaningful content.
     */
    private function isCommentWithFixableIndentation(Tokens $tokens, int $index): bool
    {
        if (!$tokens[$index]->isComment()) {
            return false;
        }

        if (str_starts_with($tokens[$index]->getContent(), '/*')) {
            return true;
        }

        $indent = preg_quote($this->whitespacesConfig->getIndent(), '~');

        if (Preg::match("~^(//|#)({$indent}.*)?$~", $tokens[$index]->getContent())) {
            return false;
        }

        $firstCommentIndex = $index;
        while (true) {
            $i = $this->getSiblingContinuousSingleLineComment($tokens, $firstCommentIndex, false);
            if (null === $i) {
                break;
            }

            $firstCommentIndex = $i;
        }

        $lastCommentIndex = $index;
        while (true) {
            $i = $this->getSiblingContinuousSingleLineComment($tokens, $lastCommentIndex, true);
            if (null === $i) {
                break;
            }

            $lastCommentIndex = $i;
        }

        if ($firstCommentIndex === $lastCommentIndex) {
            return true;
        }

        for ($i = $firstCommentIndex + 1; $i < $lastCommentIndex; ++$i) {
            if (!$tokens[$i]->isWhitespace() && !$tokens[$i]->isComment()) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    private function getSiblingContinuousSingleLineComment(Tokens $tokens, int $index, bool $after): ?int
    {
        $siblingIndex = $index;
        do {
            if ($after) {
                $siblingIndex = $tokens->getNextTokenOfKind($siblingIndex, [[T_COMMENT]]);
            } else {
                $siblingIndex = $tokens->getPrevTokenOfKind($siblingIndex, [[T_COMMENT]]);

            if (null === $siblingIndex) {
                return null;
            }

        $newLines = 0;
        for ($i = min($siblingIndex, $index) + 1, $max = max($siblingIndex, $index); $i < $max; ++$i) {

                    return null;
                }

                ++$newLines;
            }
        }

        return $siblingIndex;

namespace PhpCsFixer\Fixer\Whitespace;

use PhpCsFixer\AbstractFixer;
use PhpCsFixer\Fixer\ConfigurableFixerInterface;
use PhpCsFixer\Fixer\ConfigurableFixerTrait;
use PhpCsFixer\Fixer\IndentationTrait;
use PhpCsFixer\Fixer\WhitespacesAwareFixerInterface;
use PhpCsFixer\FixerConfiguration\FixerConfigurationResolver;
use PhpCsFixer\FixerConfiguration\FixerConfigurationResolverInterface;
use PhpCsFixer\FixerConfiguration\FixerOptionBuilder;
use PhpCsFixer\FixerDefinition\CodeSample;
use PhpCsFixer\FixerDefinition\FixerDefinition;
use PhpCsFixer\FixerDefinition\FixerDefinitionInterface;
